# A test build on html writes no document for a page served at a pattern.
# A test runs in the document it is loaded in, the stack's page at "/", and a
# `go` loads another, which ends the run whatever it loads, so no test
# reaches a page at a pattern; `sngl generate` still refuses one for a static
# site. The build refused it before, so a test of a program whose stack holds
# such a page -- a list and a page per item -- did not build on html at all.
#
# The test also changes a select beside the stack, which writes the item
# page's label as well as the home page's heading; the home document holds no
# label (testdata/nav_stack_html_other_pages_writes.txtar).

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# The page at a pattern written last: the skip hands the loop the document
# after it, which there is none of.
sngl test --platform=html last.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Item {
    name string
}

context #tone("plain")

func shout(s string) => tone == "loud" ? "{s}!" : s

component list(@open(name string)) ui.node {
    ui.text #heading(value=shout("items"))
    ui.button #first(text="first", @click { open("first") })
}

component shown(name string) ui.node {
    ui.text #label(value=shout(name))
}

component site ui.node {
    var picked = "plain"

    ui.select #pick(:value=picked) {
        ui.choice(label="plain")
        ui.choice(label="loud")
    }
    tone(picked) {
        nav.stack #pages {
            nav.page #item(href=`/items/{name}`, title="Item", params=Item{name="first"}) {
                component content(p) {
                    shown(name=p.name)
                }
            }
            nav.page #home(href="/", title="Items") {
                list #items(@open(name) { pages.go(item, Item{name=name}) })
            }
        }
    }
}

func testTheToneReachesThePage(t test.Test, c site) {
    t.assert(c.items != null && c.items.heading.value == "items")
    c.pick.change("loud")
    t.assert(c.items != null && c.items.heading.value == "items!")
}

ui.window {
    site()
}
-- last.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Item {
    name string
}

context #tone("plain")

func shout(s string) => tone == "loud" ? "{s}!" : s

component list(@open(name string)) ui.node {
    ui.text #heading(value=shout("items"))
    ui.button #first(text="first", @click { open("first") })
}

component shown(name string) ui.node {
    ui.text #label(value=shout(name))
}

component site ui.node {
    var picked = "plain"

    ui.select #pick(:value=picked) {
        ui.choice(label="plain")
        ui.choice(label="loud")
    }
    tone(picked) {
        nav.stack #pages {
            nav.page #home(href="/", title="Items") {
                list #items(@open(name) { pages.go(item, Item{name=name}) })
            }
            nav.page #item(href=`/items/{name}`, title="Item", params=Item{name="first"}) {
                component content(p) {
                    shown(name=p.name)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

func testTheToneReachesThePage(t test.Test, c site) {
    t.assert(c.items != null && c.items.heading.value == "items")
    c.pick.change("loud")
    t.assert(c.items != null && c.items.heading.value == "items!")
}

ui.window {
    site()
}
